description: Ministry of Labour - Collective Agreement No 31 of 2024 between Sanasa, Development Bank and Ceylon Bank Employees Union.
reasoning: The gazette content is the official publication of a Collective Agreement between a bank and a trade union under the Industrial Disputes Act. This constitutes a regulatory/legal notice, as it formally publishes a legally binding agreement in accordance with an existing statute (Chapter 131). It falls under the Legal/Regulatory category, which includes statutory instruments and the formal gazetting of agreements made under legal authority. It does not concern government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or the other specialized categories like Land, Commercial, or Public Service.
